construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.feedback: List of zero to 10000 objects, each with exactly id and text
input.id: Unique trimmed nonempty string of at most 128 characters
input.text: String of 1 to 4000 characters, containing a word character after normalization
input.unknown_fields: Rejected at every input object boundary
input.json: UTF-8; duplicate object keys and nonstandard numeric constants are rejected

output.evidence: feedback_id, start, end, excerpt; offsets are zero-based Python Unicode character offsets, end-exclusive

error.error: Human-readable validation or file error; exit code 2

shared_schema.validation: One validate function enforces input constraints, output partitioning, group normalization, theme membership/counts, and excerpt equality against the original input. analyze validates both boundaries.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: NFKC Unicode normalization, casefolding and word-token whitespace joining produce the grouping key; first input occurrence supplies canonical_id; all original IDs remain in member_ids.
Whole-token keyword matches assign zero or more named themes; unmatched groups receive other. Each theme includes exactly one original canonical-text excerpt per unique group.

behavior.ordering: Groups and members follow input occurrence order; themes use delivery, price, quality, support, usability, other order.
behavior.deduplication: Normalized exact matching only; punctuation, compatibility variants and case differences can collapse. Semantic paraphrases remain distinct.

themes.other: Fallback when no named theme matches

behavior.counts: Theme unique_count counts groups; original_count counts group members. Multi-theme membership means totals across themes may exceed feedback totals.
behavior.excerpts: Full bounded canonical feedback text, not generated paraphrases; source IDs and offsets permit direct verification. Duplicate source IDs are traceable through groups.
behavior.empty_input: Success with zero counts and empty groups/themes
behavior.cli: Exactly one JSON object on stdout. Success exits 0; malformed JSON, validation errors, missing files, invalid UTF-8 and usage errors exit 2.
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: All fixture IDs and dataset labels explicitly identify synthetic data.

excluded: Sentiment, negation interpretation and statistical confidence
scope.administrative_artifact: docs\My_prompt.txt is an additional mandatory prompt log, separate from the four implementation deliverables.

coverage: CLI success, usage, file and parse errors
Duplicate JSON keys, NaN and encoding errors
